runs.about: Product designer focused on building data-driven interfaces and tools that help users understand complex systems. Combines research, prototyping, and front-end development to ship high-impact product experiences.

bullets: Led design of the DEX Tracking Platform from 0 to 1, defining information architecture and core trading workflows for the product experience.
Introduced UX risk assessments to guide feature prioritization, contributing to 50+ design improvements across core product flows.
Led company-wide design discovery to uncover UX opportunities, informing a redesigned app that increased average retention time by about 2x.
Led end-to-end design and research across trading workflows, identifying UX opportunities that reduced search time by 75%.
Built faster customer feedback loops to accelerate iteration, reducing feature feedback cycles from 2 days to 10 minutes.
Redesigned the Binance Earn homepage to improve cross-product discovery and support conversion through clearer information hierarchy.
Developed a Figma plugin to analyze 2000 CSAT and NPS survey responses, enabling designers to synthesize insights about 30% faster.
Redesigned error messaging across 6 product verticals, creating a more consistent content system that helped users recover faster and reduced churn.
Audited ShopeePay payment flows with stakeholders to identify friction and streamline the payment experience.
Planned, recruited, and conducted live usability testing with 10 participants to evaluate and refine product hypotheses.
Built and tested competing prototypes in Origami Studio and Figma to evaluate interaction patterns through A/B testing.
Identified 4 key usability improvements and translated them into UI and interaction updates that shipped.
Built part of a web app in React, developing hands-on front-end fluency that informed product design decisions.
Built components of a web app using React, demonstrating development fluency and systems thinking in front-end workflows.
Redesigned and developed an online merchandise platform that increased user donations to charities by 40%, applying product strategy and iterative design.
